model_family: 2D Epileptor network (VEP-style) on P1 SC, Bayesian inversion of SEEG log-power features (v3: reduced free set, pinned z_init, PC likelihood with analytically marginalised offsets, AR(1) residuals)
intended_use: pipeline qualification benchmark only (v3). Not a patient fit and not a clinical prediction; a fitted posterior is not a calibrated probability of seizure freedom.

qualification_verdict.pass_criterion: planted EZ rank 1 by posterior mean x0, all free-x0 R-hat < 1.05, no unexplained divergences
qualification_verdict.nuts: no post-warmup draws: NUTS (dense_e, 8 chains/arm, warmup 400, max_treedepth 10) did not finish warmup in 42 min (arm A) / 47 min (arm B); stopped at the 17:00 UTC cut-off. R-hat, ESS, divergences, treedepth: not computable (no draws)

pathfinder_32_paths.arm_B_SYN-P1v3_P2SC: EZ 58 rank 28 by mean, P(rank 1) 0.205; top 57(PZ), 40, 71; 727 s
pathfinder_32_paths.multimodality: 32 distinct per-path ELBOs per arm (spread ~50 nats)

speedup.gradient: v3 44.5 ms vs v2 21.8 ms on the same VM (0.49x, i.e. slower) because nsub 2 -> 5; per Euler step 1.2x faster
speedup.wall_clock_per_fit: v2: no complete NUTS fit (frozen settings no warmup iteration 50 in 24 min; run2 partial at 64 min); v3: Pathfinder 4-12 min, NUTS warmup not finished in 42-47 min. No end-to-end speedup demonstrated.

qualification_verdict.diagnosis: the bottleneck is not parameter count but a rugged, multimodal likelihood from structural misfit: the 2D Epileptor + linear log-power observation map cannot reproduce the 6D-generated PC1 time course (per-PC noise sigma_1 ~4x baseline at every optimum); every L-BFGS start (96/96) and every Pathfinder path (32/32) ends in a different optimum; EZ vs PZ separation is 2-4 nats in profile. Pinning z_init and restricting the free set did not remove the EZ/PZ ambiguity.
qualification_verdict.recommendation: do not use v3 for patient fitting. Next: (1) a nonlinear observation model for log power (log of gain^2-weighted source power plus noise floor) or fit generator-consistent features; (2) a time-scale parameter for the fast subsystem or nsub chosen from the data's onset rise time; (3) tempering / SMC or per-mode reporting instead of single-run NUTS; (4) the LEAD's stimulation paradigm (prespecified in the task log) before P2 transfer.

fitting_partitions.SYN-P1v3: whole 21 s synthetic segment (2 Hz features, nt=42), baseline first 5 s

observation_model: Y = (Obs - baseline median) V, V = top-24 eigenvectors of the full-window feature covariance (99.8% variance); mean = amp * (V' gain) (x_t - x_1); per-PC constant offset b_k ~ N(0, 0.5^2) marginalised analytically; residual AR(1) with shared phi and per-PC scale sigma_k ~ lognormal(log baseline SD_k, 1)
priors: x0 (40 free) N(-2.5,0.5), 122 others fixed -2.5; z_init pinned to z_eq(softmin(x0,-2.12)); K lognormal(0,1); tau0 lognormal(log10,0.6); amp lognormal(data-centred,1); phi U(-1,1)

parameter_count.free_x0_rule: max|gain| >= 25% of max U top-3 SC neighbours (40 regions), prespecified from gain/SC

variants_tried_synthetic_only: v3a nsub 2, per-PC sigma prior sd 1 (prespecified): noise absorbs the seizure, null basin amp~0.08; Pathfinder 8 paths top 45
v3b nsub 2, sigma sd 0.3; v3c nsub 2, sigma sd 0.5: null basins persist; diagnosis: 8.4 model time units too short for onset+offset
v3d/e/f nsub 5 with sigma sd 0.3/0.5/1.0: rugged multimodal L-BFGS landscape; frozen = v3f (prespecified sigma prior + nsub 5, chosen by the time-scale argument, not by EZ rank)
